solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Mexican hat grey with skin of rhino!

parts.note: grey in the sense of gloomy or dull is sombre

indicators.note: the skin of a word is its outside, so the first and last letters of rhino are taken

explanation.surface: A grey hat from Mexico trimmed with rhinoceros hide.
explanation.definitionFit: This broad-brimmed hat is the classic headwear of Mexico, an example of the category named.

clue.text: Very very average!

parts.note: so can mean very, as in 'so tired'
again, so in the sense of extremely

explanation.surface: An exclamation that something is utterly middling.
explanation.definitionFit: Something described as middling or mediocre is neither good nor bad, which is the hyphenated colloquial phrase.

clue.text: Fellow consumed eastern sea creature

parts.note: a fellow is a man
consumed means ate

explanation.surface: A man ate some exotic marine animal from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea cow is a large plant-eating marine mammal of warm coastal waters.

clue.text: Create plebs, unusually decent

indicators.note: unusually says the letters of the preceding words appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Turning common people into upright citizens, an unusual feat.
explanation.definitionFit: Decent and respectable are synonyms for conduct that meets accepted standards of propriety.

clue.text: Fight is dividing the others

indicators.note: dividing says one piece splits the other by sitting inside it

parts.note: the others are the rest

explanation.surface: A fight that splits one person from the rest of the group.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to fight against or oppose, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Couple's time out

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the word time are put out of order

explanation.surface: A pair of lovers taking a break together.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantically linked pair is colloquially called this, a common idiom in gossip columns.

clue.text: Beat broth that needs a stir

indicators.note: stirring the broth mixes up its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A cook told to beat soup that requires mixing.
explanation.definitionFit: A beat, as of the heart, is a pulse or pulsation, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Happy about bulb — not the first — becoming tree

indicators.note: about says one piece goes around another

parts.note: happy means merry

indicators.note: not the first says the opening letter of the word for bulb is removed

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A cheerful gardener watches a bulb grow into a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The mulberry is a deciduous fruit-bearing plant, an example of the category named.

clue.text: A hole, something wrong with America

parts.note: a sin is a wrongdoing
US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A complaint that America has a hole in it, something amiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Anatomically this is a cavity in the skull bones, so a hole or hollow in the body.

clue.text: A few among meerkats, ever alert

indicators.note: among says the answer lies within the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A handful of watchful meerkats standing guard.
explanation.definitionFit: More than two but not many, which is what a few means in everyday counting.

clue.text: Victory sign, justification

parts.note: V is the abbreviation for victory, as in the V sign
a sign is an indication

explanation.surface: A V-for-victory gesture offered as proof of being right.
explanation.definitionFit: Being proved right after doubt is a justification, the two nouns being close synonyms.

clue.text: Traitorous act ultimately fair

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word act

parts.note: fair in the sense of moderate or sensible means reasonable

explanation.surface: An act of betrayal, which in the end is deemed fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Conduct amounting to betrayal of one's country is described with this adjective, a synonym of traitorous.

clue.text: Heavy defeat to be had in Turkey?

definitions.meaning: a thrashing or trouncing in sport, as in a 5-0 hammering
the savoury filling cooked inside a roast bird; the capital T disguises the bird as the country

explanation.surface: A crushing loss suffered on a trip to Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a crushing sporting loss and the bread-and-herb filling of a roast bird go by this one word.

clue.text: Have dinner in attempt to find agreement

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: an attempt is a try
to have dinner is to eat

explanation.surface: Diplomats sit down to a meal hoping to strike a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal agreement between nations is a treaty, an example of the general word.

clue.text: Fish found on the sea bed?

definitions.meaning: a smoked herring, a breakfast fish
a sleeper, from kip meaning sleep, so one who naps on a bed by the sea

explanation.surface: A fish living at the bottom of the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: Kip is British slang for sleep, so the second reading is someone taking a nap on a bed at the seaside.
explanation.definitionFit: A smoked split herring, and jokingly one who kips or sleeps, both share the spelling.

clue.text: One's donated here

definitions.meaning: a gift is something given or donated

explanation.surface: A sign at a charity drop-off: donations accepted on this spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift handed over, and the adjective meaning in attendance, share this spelling.

clue.text: Listen afresh, it's glittering stuff

indicators.note: afresh says the letters of the word listen are arranged anew

explanation.surface: An instruction to hear again, apparently about something sparkly.
explanation.definitionFit: Strips of shiny metallic foil used for Christmas decoration are glittering material.

clue.text: Bridge, I fear, damaged — emergency service required

indicators.note: damaged says the letters of the preceding words are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A damaged bridge prompts a call for the emergency services.
explanation.definitionFit: The firefighting crew is one of the emergency services, alongside police and ambulance.

clue.text: Disgust, as outcast knocked over

indicators.note: knocked over, in a down clue, says the word for outcast is turned upside down

parts.note: a leper is a social outcast

explanation.surface: Revulsion felt as a social outcast is knocked to the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: To disgust is to repel, both meaning to cause revulsion in someone.

clue.text: School memo written up

indicators.note: written up, in a down clue, says the word for memo is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a memo is a note

explanation.surface: A school memo being drafted.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a famous English public school near Windsor, an example of a school.

clue.text: One voting system in chaos, make one's mark

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral

indicators.note: in says one piece sits inside another

parts.note: chaos is a mess
PR is proportional representation, an electoral system

explanation.surface: A lone voter makes a mark in a chaotic election.
explanation.definitionFit: To impress is to make a strong impression, which is the idiom of making one's mark.

clue.text: Passive passage from Sartre nicely recalled

indicators.note: recalled says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A placid extract from Sartre, nicely remembered.
explanation.walkthrough: The first two words form the definition: a passive passage. 'from' signals the hidden letters, TRENI, which 'recalled' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: Inert means inactive or passive, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Girl attending a festival

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl

explanation.surface: A girl going to a festival.
explanation.definitionFit: A gala is a festive celebration or special occasion, a synonym for festival.

clue.text: Heavy weight on board, whale food

indicators.note: on says the weight follows the board in the across entry

parts.note: a board is a plank
a ton is a heavy unit of weight

explanation.surface: A heavy load loaded on board ship, with whales somewhere nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny drifting organisms are what many baleen whales filter from the sea as their diet.
